title: ETB | Chinese New Year
description: Celebrate the Chinese New Year in Escape the Backrooms with 6 unique festive suits inspired by traditional Chinese culture, lantern festivals, lion dances, and the Year of the Horse.

# [Also available on Curseforge!](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chinese-new-year)
![Curseforge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e05fccce3fc6e0194794e33d39929c911e1e044e.png)

# Chinese New Year Suits

Bring the festive spirit of the Chinese New Year into Escape the Backrooms with six unique themed suits inspired by traditional Chinese celebrations, cultural symbols, and holiday events.

Whether you're exploring endless corridors, playing with friends, or creating screenshots, these outfits add a colorful and festive touch to your Backrooms adventure.

## Included Suits

### Brocade Suit

A traditional outfit featuring elegant decorative patterns inspired by classic Chinese fabrics.

### Golden Thread Suit

A luxurious suit decorated with golden details symbolizing prosperity, fortune, and celebration.

### Year of the Horse Suit

A special costume inspired by the Year of the Horse and its cultural significance.

### Jockey Suit

A unique horse-themed outfit designed to complement the Year of the Horse collection.

### Lantern Suit

Inspired by the beauty of Chinese lantern festivals and their bright festive atmosphere.

### Lion Dance Suit

A vibrant costume based on the famous lion dance, one of the most iconic traditions of Chinese New Year celebrations.

## Features

* 6 unique Chinese New Year-themed suits.
* Inspired by traditional Chinese culture and celebrations.
* Perfect for roleplay, screenshots, videos, and multiplayer sessions.
* High-quality cosmetic additions for Escape the Backrooms.
* Adds a festive atmosphere to your Backrooms experience.

Celebrate the holiday, explore the unknown, and stand out from other wanderers with these exclusive Chinese New Year outfits.
